messages.subject: SSL certificate problem
parts:
Dear Greg & nat-users,

I started to get the following error message when using functions from the fafbseg package such as flywire_xyz2id(), flywire_latestid(), flywire_partner_summary() etc.:  

Error in curl::curl_fetch_memory(url, handle = handle) : 
  SSL certificate problem: certificate has expired

dr_fafbseg() returns:

FlyWire

----

• FlyWire token exists but is not authorised. Set a new token with:

  `flywire_set_token()`

Error in py_call_impl(x, dots$args, dots$keywords) :

  HTTPError: 401 Client Error: UNAUTHORIZED for url: https://prodv1.flywire-daf.com/segmentation/api/v1/table/fly_v31/roots_binary

You have a valid token but python+cloudvolume access to FlyWire API is still failing!

Please ask for help at https://groups.google.com/g/nat-user using the full output of dr_fafbseg.

 

1 FlyWire/CloudVolume credential files available at

/Users/emilkind/.cloudvolume/secrets

[1] "chunkedgraph-secret.json"

 

Flywire cloudvolume URL: graphene://https://prodv1.flywire-daf.com/segmentation/table/fly_v31

Google FFN1 segmentation

----

• Set the `fafbseg.skelziproot` option:

   `options(fafbseg.skelziproot="/path/to/zips")`

  if you want to use FFN1 skeleton files!

messages.subject: Re: [nat-user] SSL certificate problem
parts:
Dear Emil,

Yes I think we've run into this as well. Details (and fix) here:

https://github.com/natverse/fafbseg/issues/125

It's a problem with certificate handling + the system curl lib on macosx.

Best,

Greg.
